headline: Senior PHP Developer
summary: PHP developer with 8+ years building and maintaining Laravel applications backed by MySQL, RESTful APIs, and AWS. Hands-on with billing and invoicing logic, transactional email, Linux system administration, and integrating multiple databases and data sources.

bullets: Built and maintained a Laravel (PHP) and MySQL platform for veterinary clinics, including complex billing and invoicing.
Set up SMTP email dispatching and templates for client reminders and transactional notifications.
Administered Linux servers and AWS infrastructure; reduced AWS costs by over $6,000/month and migrated to Docker.
Owned the GitHub organization, branching and merging strategy, code review, and system architecture decisions.
Designed and built PHP and Node.js RESTful APIs with JSON responses for 11+ web applications.
Integrated multiple data sources, syncing network-restricted Oracle databases to MySQL and PostgreSQL hourly.
Architected object-oriented Laravel MVC back-ends and data models for new systems from scratch.
Configured SMTP email templates and troubleshot production issues across Linux servers.
